note: 20 authored questions; the quiz shows 10. 'probe' controls when a question can appear: 'any' = always eligible, 'windrunner'/'skybreaker' = only offered while the player is currently leaning that way. Each option's scores are added to the running total.

questions.text: A fight breaks out in a crowded market. What pulls at you first?

options.text: The people caught in the middle of it.
Who started it, and what they'll answer for.

questions.text: You're handed command of a squad. Your first act is to…

options.text: Learn every one of their names.
Write down the rules we will all be held to.

questions.text: Which promise would be harder for you to break?

options.text: A promise to a person.
A promise to a principle.

questions.text: The law is wrong. Everyone can see it. You…

options.text: Refuse to enforce it.
Enforce it, then work to change it.

questions.text: Which failure would haunt you longer?

options.text: Someone died because I wasn't fast enough.
Someone walked free because I wasn't certain enough.

questions.text: You're airborne with Stormlight running low. One last Lashing. Spend it on…

options.text: Catching the person falling below me.
Reaching the one who pushed them.

questions.text: Pick the weapon you'd rather master.

options.text: A spear — reach, control, a wall against a charge.
A blade that unmakes what it touches.

questions.text: Your spren argues with you about a choice. You…

options.text: Hear them out. The bond goes both ways.
Hold the line. I told them what I'd do.

questions.text: Protecting everyone isn't possible. You have to choose. Do you…

options.text: Choose, and carry it.
Refuse to choose, and find a rule that decides for me.

questions.text: The person you swore to protect turns out to deserve punishment.

options.text: I still stand in front of them.
I step aside. My oath never covered that.

questions.text: What does 'strength' mean to you?

options.text: Being the one others can stand behind.
Being the one who doesn't bend.

questions.text: You lead from…

options.text: The front, with them.
Above, watching for what they'll miss.

questions.text: Someone you saved does something terrible afterwards. Was saving them a mistake?

options.text: No. What they did next is theirs, not mine.
Yes. I'm responsible for what I let into the world.

questions.text: You follow a code. Who wrote it?

options.text: I did — and I can rewrite it if I'm proven wrong.
Something larger than me. That's the point.

questions.text: There's a loophole. Using it gets the right outcome.

options.text: Feels like cheating. I'd rather win honestly.
The loophole is part of the law. Use it.

questions.text: Mercy is…

options.text: The whole point of having power.
A decision someone else already made, written into the sentence.

questions.text: Another Radiant starts ruling a city by force. You…

options.text: Try to reach them. They were one of us.
Stop them. That's exactly what we exist for.

questions.text: You're certain you're right. How much does it matter that nobody agrees?

options.text: A great deal. If everyone objects, I'm probably missing something.
Not at all.

questions.text: Last one. Which sentence would you rather have said about you?

options.text: "They came back for us."
"They kept their word. Perfectly."

questions.text: Which is worse — anarchy, or tyranny?

options.text: Tyranny. A boot on the neck is the thing I'd fly at.
Anarchy. Without order, everyone is prey.

windrunner.title: You are a Windrunner.
windrunner.blurb: You answered like someone who puts themselves between danger and other people. Windrunners bond honorspren, wield Adhesion and Gravitation, and live by a single idea: I will protect.

skybreaker.title: You are a Skybreaker.
skybreaker.blurb: You answered like someone who chooses a code and then actually keeps it. Skybreakers bond highspren, wield Gravitation and Division, and swear an oath to seek and administer justice.
